objectives.label: Build shooting speed
objectives.trainingLink: Controlled striking practice is relevant to shooting speed; the test does not identify a technique fault.
objectives.progressCheck: Compare complete shots under the same ball, setup and capture protocol; also observe target control.

objectives.label: Improve short sprint completion
objectives.trainingLink: Short start-to-gate sprint practice matches completion-time performance; it does not diagnose acceleration or maximum-speed deficits.
objectives.progressCheck: Compare complete sprints over the same distance with the same start and timing protocol.

objectives.label: Develop vertical jumping
objectives.trainingLink: Vertical jumping practice is relevant to measured height; the result does not diagnose landing or strength faults.
objectives.progressCheck: Compare complete vertical jumps using the same calibration and measurement protocol.

objectives.label: Develop horizontal jumping
objectives.trainingLink: Forward jumping practice is relevant to broad-jump distance; it does not diagnose a specific movement fault.
objectives.progressCheck: Compare complete broad jumps with the same takeoff and landing measurement protocol.

objectives.label: Build controlled dribbling at pace
objectives.trainingLink: Moving and turning with the ball is relevant to overall dribbling performance; total time does not isolate touch, turn, or weaker-foot causes.
objectives.progressCheck: Record the full standardized dribbling course and observe ball control; an estimate needs a measured finish.

objectives.label: Practice planned changes of direction
objectives.trainingLink: Planned approach, turn and exit practice matches shuttle performance; it does not measure reactive agility or diagnose braking mechanics.
objectives.progressCheck: Record the full same-distance no-ball shuttle with a visible start and finish; an estimate needs a complete retest.
